description: Notion-style collapsible toggles for Obsidian, plus a recall workflow: traffic-light grading, a floating Pomodoro timer and SM-2 spaced repetition. No manual <details> or > brackets. Works on desktop and mobile.
overview: Notion Toggle (v1.8.18) makes writing toggles in Obsidian feel like Notion: type > and space to start a toggle, Enter auto-continues to the next numbered question, pasted <details> or Notion blocks turn into proper toggles, and the code is hidden while you write. Five smart commands — Toggle, Colour (red → yellow → green), Recall, Review and Due notes — cover the daily study flow. Install via BRAT with RR-LIBRARY/obsidian-notion-toggle.

description: My AI-field expertise in one card. I work deeply with Google AI Studio, Lovable, Replit, GitHub, Hugging Face, LLM Arena, Grok, the ChatGPT playground, DeepSeek and R1, ElevenLabs, Claude, OpenAI, DeepLearning.AI and Sarvam AI — prompt design, model choice, agent workflows and shipping AI apps end to end.
overview: Hands-on with the AI tools I use every day. Build and ship: Lovable for full web apps from a prompt, Replit for writing, running and hosting code and agents in the browser, GitHub for hosting and versioning agent code.
